exposure: Strong Start birth center model of care
Insurance status (privately insured, Strong Start Medicaid, non-Strong Start Medicaid)
outcome: Antepartum transfer of care after the first prenatal appointment
cohort: 26,259 childbearing people receiving care at 45 Center for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation Strong Start birth center sites between 2013 and 2017
finding: Strong Start Medicaid beneficiaries, who received midwifery-led care with peer counselors, achieved similar maternal and newborn outcomes to privately insured consumers, while non-Strong Start Medicaid beneficiaries had higher epidural use and lower exclusive breastfeeding rates.
mod_finding: Strong Start Medicaid beneficiaries, who received midwifery-led care with peer counselors, had similar cesarean birth rates to privately insured consumers.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was measured as an outcome
